title: Puppy waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#D9A05B'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='16' ry='10' fill='#F0C27A'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='22' fill='#D9A05B'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#F0C27A'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='38' rx='9' ry='16' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(15 30 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='38' rx='9' ry='16' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-15 70 38)'/>
  <!-- inner ears -->
  <ellipse cx='31' cy='39' rx='5' ry='11' fill='#D9A05B' transform='rotate(15 31 39)'/>
  <ellipse cx='69' cy='39' rx='5' ry='11' fill='#D9A05B' transform='rotate(-15 69 39)'/>
  <!-- left eye -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='45' r='4' fill='#2E3A59'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- right eye -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='4' fill='#2E3A59'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#2E3A59'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 57 Q50 61 54 57' stroke='#8B5A2B' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#FF7A8A'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='76' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#D9A05B' transform='rotate(15 28 76)'/>
  <!-- left paw -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='85' r='5' fill='#F0C27A'/>
  <!-- right arm (waving up) -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='66' rx='6' ry='11' fill='#D9A05B' transform='rotate(-35 72 66)'/>
  <!-- right paw -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='57' r='5' fill='#F0C27A'/>
  <!-- paw pads on waving paw -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#D9A05B'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='54' r='1.5' fill='#D9A05B'/>
  <circle cx='81' cy='57' r='1.5' fill='#D9A05B'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='92' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#D9A05B'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='92' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#D9A05B'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M72 80 Q82 76 80 68' stroke='#D9A05B' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail tip -->
  <circle cx='80' cy='68' r='3' fill='#F0C27A'/>
  <!-- sparkles around waving paw -->
  <path d='M88 48 L89 52 L93 53 L89 54 L88 58 L87 54 L83 53 L87 52 Z' fill='#FFE066'/>
  <path d='M84 42 L85 45 L88 46 L85 47 L84 50 L83 47 L80 46 L83 45 Z' fill='#FFE066'/>
</svg>
